resources.string: Forward queries from the TCL search-result title to this app, without a category or movie-name allowlist. TCL processes requests first. Manual searches may also forward. Repeated old results are suppressed, so repeating the same query may stay in TCL. Does not record audio. Requires this switch and accessibility access. Actor/topic search quality depends on your content sources.
This TV may require the documented ADB authorization tool.
Long press for redacted diagnostics. Experimental: TCL T7H.
